Each step is one kind. A step may name only the keys of that kind:
- port: kind, call, port
  call: transition
  port: EventoRepository
- transition: kind, transitionId, payload
  transitionId: publicar
  payload: (none)
- effect: kind, eventId
  eventId: eventoPublicado
- transaction: kind, boundary

- context: kind, source
  source: ctx
